terminal_assignment: CROSS only after literal residual, independent recomputation, source/status/novelty audit, and replayable certificate all pass.

TIMEOUT when any required frozen row reaches its cap without another higher-precedence terminal outcome.
PRESEARCH_STOP when Phase 0 prevents arm activation.
